adams_equivalent_chrono_mechanism.reason: Published papers do not provide enough hinge coordinates, topology, body mass properties, absorber topology, and lock hardware data.

stage3a_proxy_can_continue.reason: Stage 3A remains the accepted runnable proxy branch for computed landing animations and loose coupling studies.

requirements.description: A published or CAD-defined rocket body frame and deck frame, including origin, axis directions, handedness, and units.
requirements.current_evidence: Project HAMS/Cummins deck frame is defined; the Thies/Adams rocket leg CAD frame is not published.
requirements.next_action: Use the CAD/Adams export frame or author-provided frame metadata; record any transform into the HAMS deck frame.

requirements.description: Four leg azimuths and handedness in the rocket body frame.
requirements.current_evidence: Current model assumes symmetric 45/135/225/315 deg azimuths.
requirements.next_action: Replace the assumed azimuths with CAD or paper values.

requirements.description: Per-leg 3D coordinates for lower main joint B, upper strut joint T, middle strut joint K, and footpad joint P.
requirements.current_evidence: Thies Table 4 gives B/T/K heights and PT/KP/PB lengths; full x/y/z hinge coordinates are not available.
requirements.next_action: Export hinge marker coordinates from CAD/Adams or obtain author tables.

requirements.description: Joint type and axis for every connection: revolute, spherical, universal, prismatic, fixed, or compound joint.
requirements.current_evidence: The papers show the tripod concept but not the Adams constraint graph.
requirements.next_action: Define the exact Chrono constraint graph from CAD/Adams topology before claiming Adams equivalence.

requirements.description: Telescopic absorber topology, including housing/body markers, slider axis, stroke limits, preload, extension behavior, and hard-stop behavior.
requirements.current_evidence: Only stiffness/damping/table curves and reference deformation are available; internal multi-body topology is not published.
requirements.next_action: Add absorber CAD/Adams markers and measured force law metadata.

requirements.description: Mass, center of mass, and inertia tensor for each leg body: main strut, auxiliary struts, footpad, absorber housing, piston/rod, and lock hardware.
requirements.current_evidence: Stage 3C uses explicit placeholder rod masses/inertias only as a failed diagnostic.
requirements.next_action: Use CAD mass properties or validated engineering mass budget per component.

requirements.description: Machine-readable nonlinear force-stroke and force-velocity curves with units and digitization/source metadata.
requirements.current_evidence: Thies Figure 4/5 raster curves have been digitized and connected to a Chrono table buffer branch.
requirements.next_action: Prefer original author tables or measured hardware data when available; keep raster digitization uncertainty recorded.

requirements.description: Footpad geometry, contact patch, friction model, normal stiffness/damping, restitution, and deck contact material.
requirements.current_evidence: Current model uses Li 2025 contact values and explicit material assumptions, not Thies-specific hardware data.
requirements.next_action: Replace with measured footpad/deck values or a calibrated contact model.

requirements.description: Physical locking or hold-down hardware topology, trigger condition, constraint stiffness, damping, and load path.
requirements.current_evidence: Current Stage 3 lock uses ChLinkMateFix as a proxy after stability criteria are met.
requirements.next_action: Add actual post-landing securing hardware or define this as a separate platform-side model.

requirements.description: Author-level or reliably digitized time histories for leg force, damper stroke, footpad slip, body attitude, and nozzle clearance.
requirements.current_evidence: Current registry contains table-scale checks and digitized buffer curves; many full dynamic curves remain gaps.
requirements.next_action: Digitize the remaining figures or obtain source data for pointwise validation.
